label_definition: Simple forward return from as_of_date through label_end_date in the synthetic fixture.

metric_definitions.ic: Per-date Pearson correlation; at least two usable nonconstant observations.
metric_definitions.rank_ic: Per-date Pearson correlation of average ranks.
metric_definitions.icir: Mean valid correlation divided by sample standard deviation with ddof=1.
metric_definitions.coverage: Usable matched observations divided by label observations per date.

test_universe_policy: All label observations in the synthetic fixture; missing predictions remain visible.
